notes.title: Demo v6 released!
notes.notes: [p]A big thank you to all the 3000+ players who have tried the game! I was not prepared for this amount of players willing to pour hours into destroying blocks in Mighty Miners![/p][p][/p][p]Absolutely amazing and warms my heart, thank you very much <3[/p][p][/p][p]I hear you - the screen shake has been a bit intense, and the last item on the second stage not showing up properly has been annoying. I've tried to push out a fix as quickly as possible, which means that this build is very small compared to previous ones.[/p][p][/p][p]I've fixed the frequency of the screen shake, meaning it cannot shake as often. I've also lowered the strength of the shake and added a few more options.[/p][p][/p][p]The upgrade menu now features a bit more quality of life - you can buy upgrades by clicking directly on the upgrade, and most importantly you can now [b]refund one point[/b] by right clicking (or Q on keyboard, or left action button on a controller. This makes it a lot easier to refund a point or two just to get enough to unlock a character, or if you want to adjust your build just a smidge.[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes Demo 6[/h3][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgrade menu QoL: Click to buy, right click to refund one point[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased chest spawn rate, late run[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Multi item lowered 100% total -> 50% total[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed The Edge not showing the correct items in Objectives list[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered intensity of screen shake and added more options[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item being reachable in demo when it shouldn't be[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some sprite positions and draw orders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v5 released!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Miners![/p][p][/p][p]Demo 5 is finally up after a long summer. All characters are finally in with their respective visual looks, with a bit of a naming overhaul as well ([i]Pickaxe man[/i] might not be the coolest name for a pilot of the Mighty Miner space ship).[/p][p][/p][p]Also controller support, so whip out your controller and give the demo a spin.[/p][p][/p][p]On a personal TMI level: I'm fully installed in a new office and should have more time to dedicate to adding the [strike]bugs[/strike] features and content that is left. Office is insanely cold, but the coffee is free so I can't complain.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627189/6ec31a5f54b602c697e9176668121be1b5d7a925.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes Demo 5[/h3][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Full controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Improved keyboard menu navigation[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals for all characters[/p][/*][*][p]Added Feedback button[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed and updated characters, weapons and tasks[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]None[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed deposit station health indicators not showing properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button navigation order being weird in some places[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing icons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resolution issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tons of tiny things that are too annoying to mention[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v4 released!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Miners![/p][p][/p][p]Demo 4 is here with some fixes from the Discord community, together with a lighting system that is finally making the game look a bit more alive (or dull, depending on where you stand)[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes Demo 4[/h3][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added credits menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added lighting system[/p][/*][*][p]Scout now always stay on screen[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scout can now pickup some items[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Drill to be a bit quicker and snappier[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where level up and relic menus could be active at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes heal sequence starting when game was already over[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player direction moving during pause[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stage details being incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor UI issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v3 released!
notes.notes:
Hey Miners,

If you had an issue with gems not spawning, like at all, when playing previously - this update will address that! I apologize for my clumsiness.


[h3]Patch Notes Demo 3[/h3]
* Fixed critical bug where gems were not spawning if you didn't open Options menu before starting
* Fixed save not saving properly first time the game start
* Fixed typo
